sname: 旅行先トラブル・応用編
title: 旅行先トラブル・応用編（長い掛け合い）

items.en: Excuse me, my suitcase never showed up at carousel six.
items.jp: すみません、6番のターンテーブルにスーツケースが出てきませんでした。
items.speak: Excuse me, my suitcase never showed up at carousel six.

items.en: Can I see your baggage claim tag, please?
items.jp: 手荷物引換証を見せていただけますか？
items.speak: Can I see your baggage claim tag, please?

items.en: It's still sitting in Chicago. It'll come on tomorrow's flight.
items.jp: まだシカゴにあります。明日の便で届きます。
items.speak: It's still sitting in Chicago. It'll come on tomorrow's flight.

items.en: Keep your receipts, and you can submit them online.
items.jp: 領収書を保管して、オンラインで提出してください。
items.speak: Keep your receipts, and you can submit them online.

items.en: Lemme file a report and arrange delivery to your hotel.
items.jp: 報告書を作成して、ホテルへの配送を手配します。
items.speak: Lemme file a report and arrange delivery to your hotel.
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:手続きを始める時

items.en: I'm not finding anything under that name. Could it be a different spelling?
items.jp: その名前では見つかりません。別の綴りではありませんか？
items.speak: I'm not finding anything under that name. Could it be a different spelling?

items.en: I have the confirmation email right here, with the booking number.
items.jp: 確認メールがここにあります。予約番号つきで。
items.speak: I have the confirmation email right here, with the booking number.

items.en: We're fully booked, but I can get you a room at our sister hotel.
items.jp: 満室ですが、姉妹ホテルにお部屋をご用意できます。
items.speak: We're fully booked, but I can get you a room at our sister hotel.

items.en: Is it comparable? I'd rather not end up in a closet.
items.jp: 同じくらいですか？物置は勘弁してほしいな。
items.speak: Is it comparable? I'd rather not end up in a closet.

items.en: We'll cover the taxi and a free breakfast tomorrow.
items.jp: タクシー代と、明日の朝食は無料にします。
items.speak: We'll cover the taxi and a free breakfast tomorrow.

items.en: I think my wallet was stolen on the subway about twenty minutes ago.
items.jp: 20分ほど前に、地下鉄で財布を盗まれたと思います。
items.speak: I think my wallet was stolen on the subway about twenty minutes ago.

items.en: A guy bumped into me, said sorry, and a minute later my wallet was gone.
items.jp: 男の人がぶつかってきて謝り、1分後には財布がなかった。
items.speak: A guy bumped into me, said sorry, and a minute later my wallet was gone.

items.en: First thing, call your bank and cancel the cards right now.
items.jp: まず、今すぐ銀行に電話してカードを止めてください。
items.speak: First thing, call your bank and cancel the cards right now.

items.en: Do I get a copy of the report for the insurance?
items.jp: 保険用に、報告書の写しはもらえますか？
items.speak: Do I get a copy of the report for the insurance?

items.en: The engine light just came on, and I'm in the middle of nowhere.
items.jp: エンジンの警告灯がついて、周りには何もない場所にいます。
items.speak: The engine light just came on, and I'm in the middle of nowhere.

items.en: I don't wanna risk driving any farther. It's shaking pretty bad.
items.jp: これ以上運転するのは危険です。かなり揺れています。
items.speak: I don't wanna risk driving any farther. It's shaking pretty bad.
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:やりたくない時

items.en: Stay inside the car with your hazard lights on until the truck arrives.
items.jp: レッカー車が着くまで、ハザードランプをつけて車内にいてください。
items.speak: Stay inside the car with your hazard lights on until the truck arrives.

items.en: We'll bring a replacement car, and there's no charge for the swap.
items.jp: 代わりの車をお持ちします。交換の費用はかかりません。
items.speak: We'll bring a replacement car, and there's no charge for the swap.

items.en: My connecting flight leaves in twenty minutes. Can you help me?
items.jp: 乗り継ぎ便が20分後に出発します。助けてもらえますか？
items.speak: My connecting flight leaves in twenty minutes. Can you help me?

items.en: Take the shuttle on your left, and tell the staff it's a tight connection.
items.jp: 左のシャトルに乗って、乗り継ぎがぎりぎりだと係員に伝えて。
items.speak: Take the shuttle on your left, and tell the staff it's a tight connection.

items.en: If you miss it, the airline has to rebook you at no charge.
items.jp: 間に合わなければ、航空会社が無料で別の便を手配します。
items.speak: If you miss it, the airline has to rebook you at no charge.

items.en: Is my bag gonna make it? I can't promise anything.
items.jp: 荷物は間に合いますか？約束はできませんが。
items.speak: Is my bag gonna make it? I can't promise anything.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:心配を伝える時

items.en: Gimme a sec. I need to find my passport.
items.jp: ちょっと待って。パスポートを探さなきゃ。
items.speak: Gimme a sec. I need to find my passport.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:少し待ってもらう時

items.en: Hey, buddy, you dropped your boarding pass.
items.jp: ねえ、搭乗券を落としたよ。
items.speak: Hey, buddy, you dropped your boarding pass.

items.en: Sir, I'm afraid this seat is already taken.
items.jp: お客様、申し訳ありませんが、この席はすでに埋まっています。
items.speak: Sir, I'm afraid this seat is already taken.

items.en: Ma'am, could you step over here for a moment?
items.jp: お客様、少しこちらへお越しいただけますか？
items.speak: Ma'am, could you step over here for a moment?

items.en: Dude, we're gonna miss the train if we don't hurry.
items.jp: なあ、急がないと電車に乗り遅れるよ。
items.speak: Dude, we're gonna miss the train if we don't hurry.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:急がせる時

items.en: Babe, did you grab the tickets? I can't find them.
items.jp: ねえ、チケット持った？見つからないの。
items.speak: Babe, did you grab the tickets? I can't find them.

items.en: Man, I can't believe they lost my bag again.
items.jp: うわ、また荷物をなくされたなんて信じられない。
items.speak: Man, I can't believe they lost my bag again.

items.en: Hey, Sam, you good? You look kinda pale.
items.jp: ねえサム、大丈夫？ちょっと顔色が悪いよ。
items.speak: Hey, Sam, you good? You look kinda pale.
items.note: 元の形: are you good／kind of／聞こえ方: ユー グッド／カインダ／使う場面:様子を気づかう時

items.en: I dunno. The sign says closed, but the door's open.
items.jp: 分からない。看板は閉店なのに、ドアは開いてる。
items.speak: I dunno. The sign says closed, but the door's open.
items.note: 元の形: I don't know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:知らないと言う時

items.en: Beats me. I've never seen this machine before.
items.jp: さあね。この機械は初めて見たよ。
items.speak: Beats me. I've never seen this machine before.
items.note: 元の形: it beats me／聞こえ方: ビーツミー／使う場面:全く分からない時

items.en: Ya think they'll let us in without a reservation?
items.jp: 予約なしで入れてくれると思う？
items.speak: Ya think they'll let us in without a reservation?
items.note: 元の形: do you think／聞こえ方: ヤ シンク／使う場面:予想を聞く時

items.en: Whatcha doing here so early? The place doesn't open till ten.
items.jp: こんなに早く何してるの？店は10時まで開かないよ。
items.speak: Whatcha doing here so early? The place doesn't open till ten.
items.note: 元の形: what are you／聞こえ方: ワッチャ／使う場面:気軽に聞く時

items.en: Didja check the gate number? It might've changed.
items.jp: ゲート番号は確認した？変わったかもしれないよ。
items.speak: Didja check the gate number? It might've changed.
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:確認する時

items.en: I gotta call the bank before they close.
items.jp: 閉まる前に銀行に電話しなきゃ。
items.speak: I gotta call the bank before they close.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:やるべきことを言う時

items.en: We hafta be at the airport two hours early.
items.jp: 空港に2時間前に着かなきゃ。
items.speak: We hafta be at the airport two hours early.
items.note: 元の形: have to／聞こえ方: ハフタ／使う場面:やるべきことを言う時

items.en: Y'know, this isn't how I pictured the first day.
items.jp: ほら、初日がこんなふうになるとは思ってなかった。
items.speak: Y'know, this isn't how I pictured the first day.
items.note: 元の形: you know／聞こえ方: ヤノウ／使う場面:しみじみ言う時

items.en: Long story short, we ended up sleeping at the airport.
items.jp: 要するに、空港で寝る羽目になったんだ。
items.speak: Long story short, we ended up sleeping at the airport.

items.en: Look, I know it's not your fault. I'm just really tired.
items.jp: いいかい、君のせいじゃないのは分かってる。ただ本当に疲れてるんだ。
items.speak: Look, I know it's not your fault. I'm just really tired.

items.en: I mean, it could've been worse. At least nobody got hurt.
items.jp: つまり、もっとひどくなってたかもしれない。少なくとも誰もけがしなかった。
items.speak: I mean, it could've been worse. At least nobody got hurt.

items.en: Wait, what? They canceled the whole flight?
items.jp: 待って、何？便が全部欠航？
items.speak: Wait, what? They canceled the whole flight?

items.en: Say again? The announcement was too loud to hear.
items.jp: もう一度言って？アナウンスがうるさくて聞こえなかった。
items.speak: Say again? The announcement was too loud to hear.

items.en: Just talk normally. I don't understand the jargon.
items.jp: 普通に話して。専門用語は分からないから。
items.speak: Just talk normally. I don't understand the jargon.

items.en: Chill. We've got three hours. We'll make it.
items.jp: 落ち着いて。3時間あるから、間に合うよ。
items.speak: Chill. We've got three hours. We'll make it.

items.en: No can do. The next shuttle's not till noon.
items.jp: それは無理だね。次のシャトルは正午までないよ。
items.speak: No can do. The next shuttle's not till noon.

items.en: Sounds good. Let's meet at the info desk at six.
items.jp: いいね。6時に案内所で会おう。
items.speak: Sounds good. Let's meet at the info desk at six.

items.en: Need a hand with those bags?
items.jp: その荷物、手伝おうか？
items.speak: Need a hand with those bags?

items.en: C'mon, let's find a place to sit down and sort this out.
items.jp: ほら、座れるところを見つけて、片づけよう。
items.speak: C'mon, let's find a place to sit down and sort this out.
items.note: 元の形: come on／聞こえ方: カモン／使う場面:促す時

items.en: Any luck finding a taxi? It's pouring out there.
items.jp: タクシーは見つかった？外は土砂降りだよ。
items.speak: Any luck finding a taxi? It's pouring out there.
